portfolio.turnover: one-half of the absolute trade in the unit-long/unit-short signed portfolio, with each leg drifted by realized total stock returns before rebalancing

inference.family: Six primary net-return differences: rolling60-minus-frozen and expanding-minus-frozen within each of neural, ridge, and tree at value weights and 25 bps.

scope: First transaction-cost-aware economic-value audit of archived 2000-2019 stock-level predictions. No model, prediction, sort breakpoint, weighting definition, cost grid, or later-period outcome may be changed or accessed in this run.
claim_boundary: This is an in-sample-period economic audit of already evaluated forecasts, not an untouched portfolio confirmation. It determines whether economic-value work is worth carrying into a separately locked 2020-2025 test.
